parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias of the vulnerability.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
> Call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in the query results. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: CveId
parameters.description: The CVE ID of the vulnerability.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset group.

parameters.name: ImageDigest
parameters.description: The SHA256 value of the image digest.

parameters.name: ImageLayer
parameters.description: The layer of the image.

parameters.name: ImageTag
parameters.description: The tag of the image.

parameters.name: IsLatest
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query vulnerabilities of only the latest image. If this parameter is not set, vulnerabilities of all images are queried. Valid values:

- **0**: No.
- **1**: Yes.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the vulnerability.

parameters.name: Necessity
parameters.description:
The priority level for fixing the vulnerability. Valid values:
- **asap**: high-priority vulnerability (typically a high-risk vulnerability)
- **later**: medium-priority vulnerability (typically a medium-risk vulnerability)
- **nntf**: low-priority vulnerability (typically a low-risk vulnerability).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of image vulnerabilities to display on each page during a paging query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that 20 image vulnerabilities are displayed on each page.

parameters.name: PatchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vulnerability patch.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: RuleTag
parameters.description:
The vulnerability tag. Valid values:

 - **AI**: vulnerabilities related to AI components.

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description: The collection of scan ranges.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of vulnerability to query. Valid values:
- **cve**: image system vulnerability
- **sca**: image application vulnerability.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The list of unique IDs of asset instances. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
